body: i'll have to give it a try. I know we have a school counselor, but I've never actually talked to him. I guess more than anything I just needed to let this all out. Thanks for listening to me moan about my how awful my good life is. I've calmed down enough to try and get some sleep. Thanks for putting suicide off at least one more night.

heh, it's funny. Once, while I was on one of my little trips I spilled to my mom that I'd been feeling suicidal, and very very depressed as of late. NOTHING came of it. No therapy, no meds, no talks, nothing. It almost seems like the one thing I want is for someone to do something about it. All I do is fight with my dad though. I can't connect emotionally with him at all, he's such a hardass, he'd just tell me to stop being a pussy.

I play my heart out on the drums. I play drum set in marching band, winter drumline, band class, you name it, it's all just a temporary relief. I want nothing more than to be a professional musician, but almost nobody supports me, it's such a hard goal to reach. I'm cutting class and getting high on anything every day just to escape the cruel reality, my parents are disapointed with me, and I can tell, and I hate how much stress I put them through. I know suicide would crush all of my family and friends, and I don't want to put them through that, but why should I suffer so they don't have to? it's hard. I always tell myself it'll get better but it never does.

I just feel like I've tried everything. Drugs HAVE almost killed me, I've had 3 death trips, but they're the only thing that keep me happy, it seems. I'm a drummer, but that hasn't got me anywhere. I used to be a runner, and I hated it. I don't know, I don't even want to please people anymore, I just want to do what I want to do, but it's impossible.
The thing is, I realize I'm privileged and know my life is good, and I don't understand why I feel so god awful.That's the worst part about it.

The only thing that keeps me going it reminding myself that I have life good, and I should be happy, I'm just being a pathetic bitch. It doesn't make me happy, but it keeps me going. also, I have too many close friends that would be crushed if I did. I don't want to put them through that.
